description: Exploratory follow-up frozen after inspecting CSA reconstruction/router results. No pristine-final claim.
representations: All seven frozen CSA rank pairs, all matched-latent/budget PCA ranks, raw_delta, base; identical classifier/gate grids.
selection: LDA direct: maximize native score, ties prefer larger shrinkage. Prior/benefit gates: include always-own; require native and macro accuracy at least task-ID, worst accuracy at most .01 below; maximize native, then macro accuracy, then fewer switches; remaining ties prefer always-own, then larger shrinkage and larger margin. Gate selection constraints do not guarantee final safety.
benefit_target: For each alternative expert, predict help (+1), tie (0), harm (-1) relative to own expert using regularized LDA; exclude its own-task rows from that expert's fit. Expected benefit = P(help)-P(harm). Switch only above the frozen threshold.
task_prior: Predict min-GT-NLL expert probabilities with LDA; switch only if best alternative probability exceeds own probability by the frozen margin, otherwise keep task-ID.
roles: 512 coefficient_fit for scalers, classes and discriminants; 512 selection for hyperparameters; lock all choices before reading 1024 internal final. Reuse frozen response bases without refitting. Earlier finals are already explored.
scope: Offline all-expert response information probe; no additional teacher seeds, no weight compression or serving acceleration claim. Publish nonzero switch/help/harm and full rank grid; no final-selected best rank.
